'''''Gar-Jen vs. Gargantua''''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] in the [[Jedi Action genre]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nek Lawsirk]] rented it from [[Hedrett Holovid]], a holovid shop that was located in [[Hedrett]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
